title: VanillaDisplays
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af56ed081b19ad8d0484d8c6799199e1cb1e8af3.png)
**Bring text displays into vanilla survival!**  
  
  
To craft fixed text display, you need paper, ink sac and any dye, then you need to rename the item on anvil and place it into frame (glowing frame makes text glow!).  

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3101be155f557a2a547216f9e1adc25d10b40118.png)  

> Tip #1: Use `\n` for newline, while renaming text item.  
  
  
![Rotating text's recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5661c469cf8b3f6d76ccce7126b08cbb41331f77.png)
To craft rotating text display, you need ender pearl and ink sac, then you rename it and place it into frame.  

To break text, left click on it. **Warning! It won't drop after you break it.**
  
> Tip #2: You can click RMB to rotate texts that were placed on the floor/ceiling.
